rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Residential stretch of Swann Road with homes 12-20 m away, cars parked opposite.
reasons: Homes 10-25 m from the south kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 10-12 m from the kerb around 18 m and 38 m; nearest to this section is about 12-20 m. Apartments 20 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with a lane of room beside it; cars are parked along the road in both images. No pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Swann Road is a through road with traffic both ways and a junction at the end.
drivers.convention: Signs: 1P Mon-Fri 9am-5:30pm (daytime only) and no stopping Mon-Fri 7-9am, so a van must leave before 7am on weekdays.

flags: Steep: 4.5% at the section, 5.3% mean, 8.6% max
sun_shade: Street and garden trees shade the section from the south and afternoon west; open to the north.
cannot_judge: Whether signs on site match the council data

best_section.where: Mid-block on the south side, in front of the tree-shaded gap between houses
